opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, not eligible for government tuition fee support, and studying an eligible undergraduate degree at a Scottish Institute of Higher Education (including universities and designated colleges).
opportunities.summary: Grants cover tuition fees up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students from low‑income households studying at Scottish higher education institutions.
